title: Define Room database schema & entities
description: Implement all Room entities and DAOs per docs/DESIGN.md section 3: Warden, Hostel, Floor, Room, Bed, Tenant, TenancyAgreement, Invoice, Payment, TenantNote, Expense. UUID primary keys, createdAt/updatedAt on every entity.
acceptanceCriteria: All entities from DESIGN.md section 3 exist with matching fields
IDs are UUID strings, not autoincrement
Room compiles and generates a working schema export

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting - building Room entities/DAOs/database per DESIGN.md section 3: Warden, Hostel, Floor, Room, Bed, Tenant, TenancyAgreement, Invoice, Payment, TenantNote, Expense. UUID string PKs, createdAt/updatedAt epoch millis.

Scope note: DESIGN.md section 3's code sketch omits updatedAt on Warden, Payment, and Expense, but the prose right above it says every entity carries createdAt/updatedAt, and this ticket's AC says the same. Went with the explicit universal rule (added updatedAt to all 11 entities) rather than the possibly-abbreviated code block. Flagging in case Product Owner intended those three to be createdAt-only.

Built all 11 entities (com/lodgy/app/data/entity/*.kt: Warden, Hostel, Floor, Room, Bed, Tenant, TenancyAgreement, Invoice, Payment, TenantNote, Expense) with UUID string @PrimaryKey (default-generated) and createdAt/updatedAt Long epoch-millis on every one, plus the 8 status/category enums (entity/Enums.kt). Added FK constraints + indices on every child->parent reference (e.g. Bed.roomId -> Room.id) matching the design doc's hierarchy. One DAO per entity under data/dao/*.kt with insert/update/delete/getById plus a natural list-by-parent Flow query (e.g. FloorDao.getByHostelId). data/Converters.kt has @TypeConverter pairs for all 8 enums, registered via @TypeConverters(Converters::class) on data/LodgyDatabase.kt (the @Database class, version=1, exportSchema=true, lists all 11 entities + 11 DAO accessors). Wired data/di/DatabaseModule.kt (Hilt @Module, SingletonComponent) providing the LodgyDatabase singleton via Room.databaseBuilder and each DAO, since nothing could otherwise get an instance and every future ticket needs this. Added ksp { arg("room.schemaLocation", ...) } to app/build.gradle.kts so schema export actually runs. Note: the entity class is named Room per DESIGN.md, same simple name as androidx.room.Room (the DB builder) - only DatabaseModule.kt needs both, and it only references androidx.room.Room (never imports the entity), so no import collision in practice; flagging so nobody adds an unqualified androidx.room.Room import next to the entity import in the same file. Verified: `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL (kspDebugKotlin, hiltJavaCompileDebug, dexBuilderDebug all ran clean). Confirmed app/schemas/com.lodgy.app.data.LodgyDatabase/1.json was generated with all 11 tables, each PK 'id' with TEXT (string) affinity - AC #2 and #3 satisfied. No existing test suite yet to run (greenfield). Tester: worth eyeballing the schema JSON's FK/index sections and confirming field names against DESIGN.md section 3 line by line, plus deciding on the updatedAt scope note above.

PASS on all 3 ACs. AC1: diffed every field in all 11 entity files against DESIGN.md section 3 line by line - exact match on Hostel, Floor, Room, Bed, Tenant, TenancyAgreement, Invoice, TenantNote (including nullability: moveOutDate/depositRefundAmount/photoPath/note all correctly nullable). Warden/Payment/Expense carry updatedAt beyond the section-3 code sketch, but that sketch contradicts the section's own prose ('every entity carries createdAt/updatedAt') and this ticket's description says the same verbatim - siding with the explicit universal rule over the abbreviated sketch is correct, not a deviation worth failing on. AC2: confirmed every @PrimaryKey is `val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()`, no autoGenerate anywhere; cross-checked the exported schema JSON - all 11 tables have PK 'id' with TEXT affinity. AC3: ran `gradlew clean assembleDebug` from a cold build (not just incremental) - BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 42/42 tasks executed including kspDebugKotlin; app/schemas/com.lodgy.app.data.LodgyDatabase/1.json regenerated correctly after the clean, all 11 tables present. Also verified FK/index structure in the schema JSON matches DESIGN.md's parent-child hierarchy exactly (hostels->wardens, floors->hostels, rooms->floors, beds->rooms, tenancy_agreements->tenants+beds, invoices->tenancy_agreements, payments->invoices, tenant_notes->tenants, expenses->hostels), each with a supporting index. DatabaseModule's androidx.room.Room / entity Room naming note checked - no actual import collision in the file. No test suite exists yet to run (greenfield, expected at this stage).
